messages:
alice: quick heads-up — ran a microprofile comparing FlashAttention-v2 vs fused-attn on small-batch decode (<=4 tokens) with KV cache warm. P50 went up ~18% on the fused path for short decodes. anyone seen this?
ben: ugh that matches what i saw this morning on qa nodes. seems specific to decode path + kv-cache enabled. prefill runs are fine.
carol: can you paste the perf summary? rough numbers help.
alice: sure — aggregated over 10k short requests: flash-v2 decode P50 12.3ms, fused-attn decode P50 14.6ms, P95 32ms vs 33ms. throughput similar. KV-cache hit rate ~98%.
ben: interesting that prefill unaffected. suspect extra memcpy or kernel launch overhead when small batch + kv pages. i attached a quick nvprof trace earlier (link): https://ci.internal/p/1864/flame-1864.svg
carol: saw similar flame — lots of small kernel launches in fused-attn path, cost dominates at 1-4 tokens. flash uses a single fused kernel per step?
dave: fused-attn here is the custom tiled kernel that optimizes multi-head compute but it breaks into smaller launches on decode (we pipeline QK then V) whereas flash packs the whole attention in one kernel for short sequences.
ben: here's the noisy part from the trace:
```
KernelLaunch: fused_attn_tile (latency 1.8ms x N launches)
Memcpy: kv_page_copy (0.9ms)
KernelLaunch: flash_attention_full (latency 5.2ms)
```
ben: when N is 3-4 per decode, overhead adds up.
carol: maybe the kernel selection heuristic is choosing fused for model X because of seq_len estimate. Are we using runtime seq-length histograms to pick kernel?
alice: yes, but the heuristic currently thresholds on prefill median seq_len and expected batch_size. decode path uses small-batch fallback but apparently fused is still winning the score.
dave: we probably need to inject a small-batch penalty for kernel-choice when kv_cache_enabled==true. KV page copy + launch count kills latency even if compute FLOPs lower.
perf-bot: automated microbench (model: rext-1.3, seq=1..4, kv_page=64kb) — flash-v2 wins p50 for decode in 1-4 tokens by 10-25% on 3080 nodes. Report: https://ci.internal/reports/1864
ben: quick experiment: toggle fused-attn "batch_split" to 1 in runtime config -> fused path falls back to single-launch mode and latency matches flash. tradeoff: increased shared memory, slightly higher mem usage.
carol: can we instead adjust continuous batching heuristics so small decode requests go to flash kernel by default? That keeps fused for larger batches.
dave: possible quick patch: if (is_decode && batch_size <= 4 && kv_cache) prefer_flash = true. also add metric tag so we can monitor change.
alice: that seems safe. i'd like a canary on dedicated before flipping org-wide. low-risk default config change.
ben: also want a follow-up to look at kv_page_size interaction, i saw smaller pages had more memcpy overhead. maybe page_size=256kb reduces copies.
carol: noted. i can add a synthetic microbench matrix: page_size {64,128,256}, batch {1..8}, kernel {flash,fused}. schedule it after lunch.
dave: PR ready in ~2 hrs for heuristic toggle + metric. will include toggles for page_size testing.
alice: perfect. assign canary to eng-runtime/canary-1 cluster and ping here when deployed. thanks all :thumbsup:
ben: adding perf-triage label.
perf-bot: benchmark queued: job/1864-microkernel-matrix. will post results in this thread when done.
